rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a container used for rubbish or waste.

example.english: The bin is full, so please take it out.
example.traditional: 個垃圾桶滿咗，請拎出去倒。
example.jyutping: go3 laap6 saap3 tung2 mun5 zo2 ceng2 ling1 ceot1 heoi3 dou2

rows.note: Use this for a box or similar container specifically intended for storing things.

example.english: I keep my winter clothes in a storage bin.
example.traditional: 啲冬天衫收埋喺儲物箱度。
example.jyutping: di1 dung1 tin1 saam1 sau1 maai4 hai2 cyu4 mat6 soeng1 dou6

rows.note: Use this technical term for one interval or class in a histogram or similar data display.

example.english: This histogram has five bin intervals.
example.traditional: 呢個直方圖有五個組距。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zik6 fong1 tou4 jau5 ng5 go3 zou2 keoi5
